summary: Bump the changelog-derived project version from 0.4.3 to 0.4.4 and move the software RAID, ZFS disk replace, host Version light and staged-review fix notes into the new heading. API impact: existing contract — OpenAPI x-introduced-version and Implemented-in sentences for the three new replace operations updated to 0.4.4; hardware and fence-check operations stay at 0.4.3.

guide.reason: Working-version stamps on install, updates, publish and pool guide pages move to 0.4.4; operator workflows unchanged.

api.reason: No operation behaviour change. POST /api/v1/storage/zfs/replace, POST /api/v1/hosts/{id}/system-disk and peer POST /api/v1/pool/zfs-provision/replace now declare x-introduced-version 0.4.4 and Implemented in development product 0.4.4; host hardware and fence-checks remain 0.4.3.

roadmap.reason: Release metadata only; phase gates unchanged.

state.reason: No durable product setting or resource is introduced.

verification.method: python3 scripts/release-version.py --current --format both and --tag v0.4.4 both return 0.4.4; python3 -m unittest tests.test_release_version; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree scoped to this change where possible.
